title: There were people I seen hating on my auto bot. The point was to just show how impressed I was but since people in here calling me a spam and fake here are results. I started a 10k challenge and 1k challenge last week
author: tate_tradezz
selftext: I can’t believe I just joined this community and wanted to show my results and people are calling me a spam and it’s not true and this and that. It’s just kind of sad about the haters. Like come on now. Let a dude be successful and happy about what he created. It’s always the course sellers that’ll hate on me. I have so many screen shots to prove I just ain’t a spam. Plz don’t put bad on my name when I am just trying my hardest to the game. I worked hard to create an agentic trading bot and tools man. Very bad experience joining this group!

comments.author: leroylabs
comments.body: The $10k and $1k challenges could be useful evidence, but screenshots alone will not show what the agentic bot actually controlled. Could you publish a read-only trade export with timestamps, symbols, order types, fills, fees, deposits, and withdrawals, plus the bot’s decision log for each order since last week? That would let people reconcile account equity to executed trades and distinguish autonomous decisions from manual intervention without taking anyone’s word for it.
